en.title: Variety Celebrates Young Hollywood's Brightest: McRae, Sombr, Withers, Barton Shine
en.summary: Los Angeles sizzled as Variety hosted its annual Power of Young Hollywood event, recognizing a constellation of rising stars. From chart-topping musicians to breakout actors, the evening celebrated the talent shaping the future of entertainment.
en.body:
Los Angeles, a city accustomed to its own heat, felt an extra surge of energy this past Wednesday as **Variety** hosted its much-anticipated **Power of Young Hollywood** event. Presented by **Disney+**, the gathering at the Four Seasons Beverly Hills was a vibrant showcase of the industry's most promising new talents, all gathered under one roof to celebrate their burgeoning careers.

This year's honorees represent a dynamic cross-section of the entertainment world. Grammy-nominated artist **Tate McRae**, known for her infectious pop hits and captivating stage presence, was among those recognized. Alongside her, fellow musician **Sombr** was celebrated for his songwriting prowess. The acting world was brilliantly represented by **Tyriq Withers**, whose acting résumé continues to impress, notably with his role in the romance film "Reminders of Him." Rounding out the quartet is **Malachi Barton**, a familiar face to many young audiences, who has become a staple in the **Disney Channel**'s popular "Zombies" franchise.

## A Celebration of Emerging Icons

**Variety's Power of Young Hollywood** has a storied history of identifying talent before they reach superstardom, with past honorees including names like **Zendaya**, **Megan Thee Stallion**, **Maluma**, and **Olivia Rodrigo**. This year's selection continues that tradition, spotlighting individuals who are not only making waves now but are poised to define the next decade of entertainment. The event itself, held on August 5th, brought together a dazzling array of actors, musicians, influencers, and industry executives, all eager to toast the achievements of these young artists. The atmosphere was electric, buzzing with the collective energy of ambition and success.

Madison Beer was slated to present Tate McRae with the Triple Threat Award, while Sombr was set to receive the Songwriter of the Year award, underscoring the diverse talents being acknowledged.

## What This Means for Fans

For fans of **Tate McRae**, **Sombr**, **Tyriq Withers**, and **Malachi Barton**, this recognition from **Variety** is a powerful affirmation of their favorite artists' impact. It signifies that these talents are not just niche sensations but are being acknowledged by the broader industry as significant forces. This event serves as a beacon for fans, highlighting where to direct their attention for the next wave of compelling music and performances. It's a chance to celebrate the artists they've championed, knowing that their passion is shared and validated by industry tastemakers. The presence of **Disney+** as the presenting sponsor also emphasizes the platform's commitment to nurturing and showcasing emerging talent, which is often a key driver for viewership and engagement among younger demographics.

## What's Next

With **Variety** having officially celebrated these rising stars, the focus now shifts to their future projects. Fans can eagerly anticipate new music from **Tate McRae** and **Sombr**, as well as upcoming acting roles for **Tyriq Withers** and **Malachi Barton**. Specific details on their next endeavors are expected to be announced in the coming months.
